findings.title: Knob 0's trigger tick can fall while the scripted Helm is still standing, so the helmPower is refused and never re-sent
findings.claim: Knob 0 sends helmPower +1 only when `d.tactical.tick === d.baseTick + 1`. The scripted crew does not start a round seated. Its Helm walks to its console and sends `sit` when canSit holds. It also stands up to repair, then walks back and re-sits. If the Helm is not seated at baseTick + 1, the sim refuses that one command and the condition never comes true again, so knob 0 silently does nothing. The plan also hedges with 'match the existing "first seated tick" idiom in that function if one exists', but scripted.ts has no such idiom.
findings.evidence: plan L2457 (the knob 0 text with `d.tactical.tick === d.baseTick + 1` and 'if one exists'); src/renderer/src/sim/duel/scripted.ts:L290-L311 (stand for repair, walk back, `cmds[pid]!.push({ kind: 'sit', station: own })`); scripted.ts:L315 (`if (seat === d.nav) {`, the only seated branch); grep of scripted.ts for baseTick/first seated: no match; tests/duelRuntime.test.ts:L59 ('createDuel now leaves both standing').
findings.why: The knob the plan says to try first may be a no-op, and the implementer has to guess the seated idiom. That is the kind of 'check at execution' the plan bans.
findings.fix: Drop the tick test and the 'if one exists' hedge. Inside the existing `if (seat === d.nav) {` branch of scriptedInput, push `{ kind: 'helmPower', delta: 1 }` whenever `d.compressor > 0`. This limits itself: once applied, compressor is 0. It also fires on the first seated tick of every round and after every re-sit.

findings.title: The new power line 'ENGINE n  COMPRESS n  +r%/S' reaches past the 300 px panel once the rate has two digits
findings.claim: With m5x7 advances at 16 px, 'ENGINE 3  COMPRESS 1  +5%/S' is 156 px wide. Drawn at rx = STATION.x + 140 = 152, it ends at x 308. The panel's right edge is at x 312. At compressor 3 the rate is 15, which the plan's own consoleModel test expects, and the text then ends at 314. A fractional COMPRESSOR_RATE/10 such as 12.5 would make it wider still.
findings.evidence: plan L3539 (the merged power line); plan L3382 (`compressor: 3, rate: 15`); plan L3455 (`rate: COMPRESSOR_RATE[d.compressor]! / 10`); src/renderer/src/render/theme.ts:L31-L37 (advances: letters 6, M 8, space 5, % 6, / 4); src/renderer/src/render/duel/consoleLayout.ts:L10 (STATION x 12, w 300); src/renderer/src/ui/duel/HelmStation.tsx:L29 (rx = STATION.x + 140).
findings.why: It overflows the panel's border by a few pixels at the owner's look gate.
findings.fix: Use single spaces ('ENGINE 3 COMPRESS 1 +15%/S', 151 px at a rate of 15), or abbreviate to 'COMP'. Also state that COMPRESSOR_RATE values are multiples of 10, so the rate is always an integer.
